limitations: Centered radial binary masks with strictly separated positive annuli
No uniform noise stability at coalescing or distant endpoints
No globally convergent numerical reconstruction algorithm established
Historical priority provisional, especially general finite-moment principles
scientific_integrity: Analytical global proof and sharp local nonidentifiability; finite numerical tests corroborate only. Published diagonalization, sign-change moment principle and general finite-rate innovation are credited.
title: Sharp finite Hermite spectral tomography of concentric Gaussian Gabor masks
